description: This file contains the implementation of 'applyNeonBackground', a function that sets a CSS variable for a neon background image by constructing a URL relative to the current window location. It is designed for use in a web application to dynamically apply a background image, respecting user preferences for reduced motion by avoiding animations.

methods.name: applyNeonBackground()
methods.description: Sets a CSS variable '--neon-bg-url' on the document's body to point to a specific neon background image, constructing the URL relative to the current origin.
